sections.shortTitle: Financial Institutions Recovery of Finances Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

Financial Institutions (Recovery Of Finances) (Amendment) Ordinance 2001
Financial
Institutions (Recovery Of Finances) (Amendment) Ordinance 2001
ORDINANCE LI OF 2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Financial Institutions (Recovery of Finances) Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 1st October, 2001]
No. F. 2(I)/2001-Pub., dated
29-9-2001.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Financial
Institutions (Recovery of Finances) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 30th day of August, 2001.

ORDINANCE LI OF 2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Financial Institutions (Recovery of Finances) Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 1st October, 2001]
No. F. 2(I)/2001-Pub., dated
29-9-2001.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 5,
Ordinance XLVI of 2001.---In the Financial Institutions (Recovery of
Finances) Ordinance, 2001 (XLVI of 2001), in section 5, for subsection (7) the
following shall be substituted, namely:--
(7) "The salary, allowances
and other terms and conditions of service of a person appointed as a Judge of a
Banking Court shall be such as the Federal Government may determine."
